method: Structural source review of every retained hook header, central definition/export registries and literal calls in committed C/header/Rust sources. Declarations and restricted conditions parsed with balanced parentheses. This is not semantic review of every call site or runtime execution.

exceptions.android_rvh_check_preempt_tick: Final ACK itself has no in-tree invocation; retain its declaration/export as the final generic scheduler source interface, without inventing a callback site or claiming runtime invocation.
exceptions.android_rvh_sched_getaffinity: Final ACK itself has no in-tree invocation; native port syscalls.c is byte-identical to final ACK. Retain the source interface without changing native affinity checks.
exceptions.android_trigger_vendor_lmk_kill: Definition is TRACE_EVENT in include/trace/events/android_vendor_lmk.h, with two scalar fields and scalar assignments. Export is an explicit vendor-triggered event API, not an in-tree invocation.
exceptions.android_vh_rust_binder_looper_entry: drivers/android/binder/rust_binder_hooks.c generates/exports rust_do_trace wrapper via CREATE_RUST_TRACE_POINTS; drivers/android/binder/trace.rs calls it through Rust tracepoint bindings.
exceptions.android_vh_rust_binder_restore_priority: Same Rust-generated wrapper path; literal trace_ call scanning does not expand macros.
exceptions.android_vh_rust_binder_set_priority: Same Rust-generated wrapper path; literal trace_ call scanning does not expand macros.

restricted_condition_assessment: All parsed restricted-hook conditions are literal true or nonzero integer constants. No additional conditional body or runtime expression occurs in these headers.
registry_only_assessment: Central drivers/android/vendor_hooks.c and kernel/sched/vendor_hooks.c contain only includes, tracepoint-generation definitions and GPL exports, not callback implementations. The scheduler registry is byte-identical to final ACK. Central registry omissions correspond to separately documented other-architecture/platform hooks; TTM generic hooks were restored after reviewing actual SDK configuration.
